issue.title: Don't require in a luv callback
issue.body:
See: https://github.com/neovim/neovim/issues/15147

> require invokes nvim_get_runtime_file which is marked as FAST. however
> as part as its implementation it uses regexes which can invoke
> os_breakcheck which must not be done in FAST functions.

Fixes #272

ojroques/nvim-bufdel
lewis6991/gitsigns.nvim
TimUntersberger/neogit
nvim-lua/plenary.nvim

Neovim shouldn't crash.

issue.title: E5560: nvim_get_option must not be called in a lua loop callback
issue.body:
I've hit this after the latest updates, while using nvim-dap (never happened before):

```text
Error executing luv callback:
.../site/pack/packer/start/impatient.nvim/lua/impatient.lua:138: E5560: nvim_get_option must not be called in a lua loop callback
```

nvim 0.5
